categories.main_business_segments: Prologis operates two main business segments: (1) Real Estate, which includes rental operations and development of logistics facilities, and (2) Strategic Capital, which manages co-investment ventures with institutional partners and provides asset and property management services. The Real Estate segment is the largest, contributing 85-90% of consolidated revenues, while Strategic Capital contributes 10-15%.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Prologis focuses on the development, ownership, and management of modern logistics facilities using advanced construction methods, sustainable building practices, and technology-enabled property management. The company integrates energy-efficient features such as LED lighting, solar panels, and smart building systems, and leverages data analytics and digitization to optimize operations and customer solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Prologis serves over 4,000 customers in its consolidated portfolio (6,700 in the owned and managed portfolio), primarily large multinational, national, and regional logistics users. Key customer industries include e-commerce, retail, transportation, third-party logistics, consumer goods, and manufacturing, with top tenants such as Amazon, Home Depot, FedEx, UPS, and DHL.
categories.geographic_coverage: Prologis operates in 19 countries across North America, Europe, Asia, and South America, with a portfolio totaling approximately 1.2 billion square feet. The majority of assets and revenues are in the United States, but the company also has significant holdings in Europe (notably the UK, Germany, France, and the Netherlands), Asia (Japan, China, Singapore), and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Canada).
categories.supply_chain_position: Prologis operates downstream in the supply chain as a provider of logistics real estate, offering warehousing, distribution, and fulfillment facilities that serve as critical nodes for last-mile and city distribution, as well as gateway and regional distribution centers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Prologis prioritizes growth in high-barrier, high-growth markets, expanding its development pipeline, and enhancing its Strategic Capital business. The company invests in sustainability (renewable energy, green buildings), digital innovation (data analytics, customer experience platforms), and new business lines through Prologis Essentials and Prologis Ventures, focusing on emerging logistics technologies and supply chain solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Prologis generates revenue primarily through rental income from operating leases, including recoveries of property operating expenses, and through development and management fees from its Strategic Capital segment. Additional revenue streams include asset and property management fees, transactional and promote fees from co-investment ventures, and gains from property dispositions and contributions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Prologis is the global leader in logistics real estate, with a distinct competitive advantage due to its scale, global reach, and focus on high-barrier markets. Key competitors include other large industrial REITs and logistics property owners such as Goodman Group, GLP, Segro, and Blackstone, as well as regional and national operators. Prologis differentiates itself through its extensive portfolio, customer-centric solutions, and strong relationships with institutional capital partners.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2023, Prologis had total assets of $93 billion and net investments in real estate of $87.7 billion. In 2023, total revenues were $8.0 billion, with net earnings attributable to common stockholders of $3.05 billion and core FFO of $5.33 billion. The company has demonstrated strong growth through acquisitions (notably the Duke Realty transaction), development activity, and rising market rents, maintaining high occupancy (97.6%) and robust liquidity ($6.0 billion).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Prologis offers customers high-quality, well-located logistics facilities with integrated sustainability features, advanced technology, and value-added services through Prologis Essentials. Its global scale, local market expertise, and ability to provide tailored solutions for complex supply chain needs set it apart. The company emphasizes operational efficiency, supply chain resiliency, and sustainability, delivering unique value to customers, investors, and communities.
